mapper.select: select p.product_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.image_url, p.status, p.sort, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, fs.sale_id as flash_sale_id, fs.flash_price as flash_price, fs.end_time as flash_end_time, (fs.stock_limit - fs.sold_count) as flash_stock_left, ga.activity_id as ga_activity_id, ga.title as ga_title, ga.min_group_size as ga_min_group_size, ga.end_time as ga_end_time, gt.min_price as ga_best_price from mall_favorite f join mall_product p on p.product_id = f.product_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join mall_flash_sale fs on fs.product_id = p.product_id and fs.status = '1' and now() between fs.start_time and fs.end_time left join mall_group_activity ga on ga.product_id = p.product_id and ga.status = '0' and now() between ga.start_time and ga.end_time left join ( select activity_id, min(price) as min_price from mall_group_tier group by activity_id ) gt on gt.activity_id = ga.activity_id where f.member_id = #{memberId} order by f.create_time desc
SELECT product_id FROM mall_favorite WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mall_favorite WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO mall_favorite (member_id, product_id, create_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mall_favorite WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId}
